descriptions.w3d_d24h_names_add_800c47f8: Adds a name at index 0 of the 33-byte name list at +4: fills a record with zero digits (0x80344360), copies at most 33 characters of the name, grows the list when full (new capacity max(size + 1, size + size / 2) * 33 bytes, with the byte size treated as the count, as in the original), then shifts the records with memmove and stores the record. Returns 0.
